$doc: §23.6 ST-1. The design's 'mounted company' is a mounted PLATOON here: no TKB composite carries a company's vehicles, so the holdings (8 wheeled HMMWV, type 102) are authored - the fill keeps authored holdings and fills only the slot table. Wheeled in woods = M-1 forbids (UnitSpeedModel.WoodsWheeled); the prediction is computed offline from the measured route (the road polyline: UnitRoute.Length) with UnitSpeedModel (the TKB top speed of type 102 for BaseSpeed, factor 1 on the road). NO golden: a captured one differed once in five runs (the unit's position one 16.7 m/s step off from t = 15 s - a start-frame jitter, finding F-13), so the conditions judge it.

expect.name: it routes by the roads (a planner's route, not the straight leg)
it never enters the wood (west half)
it never enters the wood (east half)
its tail arrives within +-10 % of the predicted time
